quest.title: Not to be Missed
quest.description: The storm has subsided, but Cyrus seems displeased...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x8000, Guide to Freedom x1

talks.objective: Check the suspicious location and eliminate any threats

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There are still monsters out and about...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Monsters are still in the area, eh? So it seems that the effects of the Storm have yet to disperse...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Hahaha! So there's still time, then — time for the Adventurers' Guild to show its quality.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: It is up to us to take those monsters out in the wild on, while the Knights of Favonius are still focused on defending the city and the area around Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I understand. Thanks for your help in investigating. I will reconsider the commissions that we will be sending out. Take these as your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: *sigh* Where has that kid Bennett run off to? I hope he didn't run into any trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Strange, that was over so quickly...
